messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - generate-endpoint (eu-west-1) is spiking 5xx. AlertID: ALRT-7f3a. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/ALRT-7f3a

pagerduty-bot: page fired to rotation: oncall-platform (1/3). Escalation policy: platform-oncall.

mike: acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and checking HPA. pinging @alex for autoscaler deep-dive.

alex: oncall here, joining. quick glance at k8s metrics shows HPA for inference-autoscaler not scaling in last 12m. grabbing logs now.

alex: command I'm running: ```kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-autoscaler -o yaml``` ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler --since=15m```

sarah: saw customer error reports from hosted generate in eu-west-1 — approx 25% requests returning 5xx intermittently. Not yet a public incident; i'll standby for >15m sustained.

mike: digging into prometheus: request_rate steady, but replica_count stuck at 2 while CPU/RPS targeting indicates should be 10. suspect metrics mismatch (HPA using cpu not custom rps).

alex: confirming — frontend metric name changed in a recent deploy, HPA target metric is now missing. that explains no scale up under load. plan: (1) restart autoscaler to pick up config (2) force temporary routing fallback to smaller model for eu to reduce per-request CPU. opinions?

julia: +1 to fallback while we fix autoscaler. also recommend a temporary token-rate limit to avoid thrash.

mike: i'll add a short-lived ingress rate limit for hosted-generate-eu via gateway: ```gwctl set-rate-limit --region eu-west-1 --route /v1/generate --limit 20rps``` will monitor.

alex: rolling restart autoscaler now: ```kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/autoscaler```

deploy-bot: deployment/autoscaler: rollout started (uid: rOll-9a). watching status...

alex: logs show autoscaler picked up metrics after restart, beginning scale decisions. patching routing to force fallback to model-small for eu: ```redwoodctl config set routing.europe.force_fallback true --env prod```

incident-bot: Note: applied temporary routing override for eu region (operator: alex).

mike: monitoring dashboards: error rate trending down from 28% -> 6% over last 8 minutes. latency also recovering.

sarah: from product side — impacted customers: 3 small hosted customers with high RPS. i'll prepare a short message if we don't hit <5% in next 10m.

julia: added a temporary alert to watch error_rate_eu > 10% for 5m so we don't miss a rebound.

mike: confirming: current 5xx rate ~3.2% last 2m, p50 latency back to baseline. looks stable.

alex: i'll open a postmortem and a bug for autoscaler metric config drift. will assign to infra-team and tag for priority-1 fix.

sarah: thanks. i'll hold off on customer comms for now, but prepping text in case we need: "We observed elevated errors for hosted generation in eu-west-1. Mitigation applied; working on root cause and will follow up."

mike: moving to monitoring phase. oncall handoff plan: alex will own follow-up and patch, mike will update rotation notes.

alex: acknowledging ownership for follow-up. creating ticket now.

deploy-bot: deployment/autoscaler: rollout completed successfully. (duration: 45s)

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert ALRT-7f3a acknowledged by mike, status: mitigation in progress.

mike: closing the active page if everyone is happy with mitigation. anyone object?

julia: fine from SRE side. suggest 24h watch on eu metrics and then close.

sarah: fine. will prepare a short internal write-up for CS/Support.

mike: closing page. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert ALRT-7f3a resolved (manual close by mike).
